description.value: Molly Hogan's Bar & Grill is the social anchor of Sasquatch Mountain Resort in Hemlock Valley, serving hearty comfort food, rotating seasonal menus, and local craft beers from both a cozy indoor lounge and an outdoor deck with alpine views. The venue doubles as an après-ski hub in winter and a natural base-area refuelling stop for mountain bikers in summer, with the resort operating a dedicated trail network and bike-focused programming. Live music on select evenings adds to its reputation as the gathering place at the heart of the resort.
